授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート:
You will be assessed on your in-class and homework writing tasks (100%).
Students will analyse sample research papers, identify important language components, and write sample sections. Each class will involvereading and writing.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
【Caution】 You must create and submit original work for this class. Plagiarism (剽窃), e.g., copying and pasting from the internet,isunacceptable. If you use information from research papers or the internet, you must cite the source, e.g., author’s name and dateorURL. Students who plagiarise will fail the course.
【Caution】 The use of generative AI and automatic translation apps is prohibited. Students who use tools such as generative AIorautomatic translation apps will fail the course.
